author: TeIq
content: Delivered: pages/case_view.rs with leptos_router /cases/:subject_id route mounted in app.rs. 5 components — subject_header, history_timeline (with j/k keyboard nav + ARIA active-descendant), report_list, action_composer (reasoning >=10 gate + live counter + aria-live error), network_panel (placeholder for M2). PolarisApiClient extended with get_case, list_incidents, submit_action, escalate — both native and wasm impls. DTOs duplicated in api_client/dto.rs matching backend serde-compatible (decision: duplication over polaris-api-types workspace crate split until drift becomes real). Resource per fetch, ErrorBoundary at boundaries, Suspense fallbacks for loading states.
